description.p: PaneFlow is a native terminal workspace for running coding agents in parallel. Launch Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Pi, or any CLI agent in real panes, keep each session visible, and react when one needs input.

ul.li: One-click coding-agent launchers with per-session status tracking
Horizontal and vertical split panes with drag-to-resize, up to 32 panes
Branch-aware workspaces with rename, quick-switch, and session restore
In-app Git diff viewer and branch review prompts for agents
MCP bridge so capable agents can read other panes without copy/paste
JSON-RPC 2.0 IPC for local automation and integrations
Native Rust/GPUI rendering with Wayland and X11 support on Linux

description.p: Workspace navigation and terminal legibility update.

ul.li: The sidebar now uses simpler workspace-first navigation with persistent agent completion indicators
Workspace actions expose rename, workflow, local service, editor, reveal, and close controls in one context menu
JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono is bundled as the cross-platform terminal default
One Dark and Cursor terminal palettes now use softer ANSI colors and restrained bold intensity
Long workspace titles now truncate cleanly inside sidebar cards
Active session indicators remain visible beside long workspace names
Rename fields and horizontal overflow stay contained within the sidebar

description.p: Windows updater recovery and release hardening update.

ul.li: Windows MSI publisher verification now matches the StriveX signing certificate exactly
Windows release smoke tests guard the pinned publisher against the signed MSI artifact
GitHub releases remain draft-only until every signed asset is uploaded and verified

description.p: Theme, Windows launch, and interface polish update.

ul.li: Vercel, Claude, and Cursor theme presets added with bundled Geist and Geist Mono fonts
Windows browser, editor, folder, taskbar, Start Menu, and notification launch behavior hardened
Terminal hyperlink hover and sidebar diff stats simplified for cleaner daily use

description.p: Major control-plane, terminal, and release-hardening update.

ul.li: Agent orchestration, MCP bridge scoping, and workspace automation hardened
Session restore, tabbed panes, terminal rendering, search, and diff workflows stabilized
Signed self-updates, Windows MSI, macOS DMG, Debian, RPM, AppImage, Homebrew, and Winget release gates tightened
Windows MSI, macOS DMG, Homebrew, Debian, RPM, and AppImage release checks tightened
openSUSE zypper update routing added for RPM installs
Debian repository keyring shipped with the package payload

description.p: Linux release hardening patch - closes 10 debt items from v0.2.0.

ul.li: Per-package RPM signing re-enabled - `rpm --checksig` now returns OK on every shipped .rpm
Release → repo-publish auto-chain via workflow_run (no more manual dispatch after each tag)
Post-publish Ubuntu + Fedora end-to-end smoke tests in CI
reprepro arch-idempotency CI regression guard
cargo-deny advisory scanning on every PR (warn-only)
Windows Explorer reveal-in-file-manager argument concatenation fix
GitHub Actions upgraded to Node.js 24 runtime

description.p: Linux packaging migration release - complete Phase 1 + Phase 2.

ul.li: Native .deb, .rpm, .AppImage, and .tar.gz artifacts for x86_64 and aarch64
GPG-signed APT + RPM repositories hosted at pkg.paneflow.dev
Per-install-method auto-updater with 30s network timeout and SHA256 integrity verification
SHA256 sidecars on every release asset
Cross-platform polish: per-OS reveal-in-file-manager dispatch, macOS Core Text font fallback
Sidebar: empty state, clear-all, drag-and-drop reorder
Tabs: double-click the tab bar to open a new terminal
